generation: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game prop for PipaKlub. Reference is Rabbito's character design; create the physical unfinished kite that precedes this living creature, NOT a living rabbit. A FLAT handmade paper kite viewed from directly above on an invisible craft desk: cream and turquoise cut paper forming a rabbit silhouette with two long pointed ears and short pointed bottom, dark blue INK drawn face on the paper, bamboo frame structure exposed behind the paper, one thin bamboo cross brace missing and lying separately to the right ready to install. No tail, no ochre bows, no paws or three-dimensional living body, no sparkles. Faithful rabbit ear silhouette and colors of reference but visibly a paper craft object. Single kite and one separate bamboo brace only. Clean outlined cel-shaded 2D illustrated RPG asset. Landscape1536x1024 transparent RGBA. Whole kite centered left two-thirds, brace isolated in right third, ample transparent padding all edges. No hands, no people, no desk/background, no text, no frame, no cast shadow. Actual alpha transparency. This is an inert prop before a magical birth.
cleanup: Precise-object-edit of this production game prop. Preserve the exact kite-bunny design, face, colors, all bamboo outlines and the separate bamboo brace, same arrangement and proportions. Remove ONLY ALL surrounding colored glow, gray/blue/brown haze, all background and shadows. The result must be a clean hard-edged outlined cel-shaded sprite on genuinely transparent alpha, every pixel outside the outlined kite and brace completely transparent. Keep the kite itself opaque, no holes cut through paper. No added objects or changes to identity. This prop has no magic yet. Preserve generous padding and full outlines.
